provenance.note: R7: bench/native_flash.py (pinned in the input package; created in DEVELOPMENT) empties run/FprimeRustReference/, copies the delivered executable (no suffix) to {install}, chmod +x, and prints 'Serial# = native-<hostname>'; bench/native_dump.py (same) copies {install} back to {readback} so fth's flash read-back hashes equal to the image. The GDS launches the app from run/FprimeRustReference/ (fresh PrmDb.dat per run). bench/native_recorder.py (same) is the recorder: it runs fprime-cli events (untouched output under record/raw/recorder-native/) and re-renders each row's own (tb(ctx)-sec:usec) stamp into the TB_PROC_TIME row form fth 0.1.2 exports; the deployment's Svc.PosixTime stamps TB_WORKSTATION_TIME, which fprime-gds prints as an ISO date that fth's exporter does not parse. bench/native_send.py (same) is the sender: it runs fprime-cli command-send unchanged (its log kept verbatim under record/raw/cmd/send-native/) and logs the arguments as given on the command line (decimal integers as integers), because fth 0.1.2 slices window commands by comparing the marker row's first argument with the marker id as an integer and fprime-cli logs CMD_NO_OP_STRING's argument as a string. The sender also resolves fth short command names (the window marker) to the full dictionary name. serial is this host's: bench/native_flash.py prints 'Serial# = native-<hostname>' and fth audit compares it with bench.serial.

notes: DUMP RUN bench (A19): the same twin runs test/int/gcov-dump (DUMP_COVERAGE walk) right after the coverage run; the flash step must NOT touch the .gcda files (they hold the coverage run's counters). Identical to bench.json otherwise. Development evidence only. Native Linux x86_64 host, no hardware. Relative paths only, from the campaign root; the dictionary path is the uut build-artifacts tree and relies on the package's dictionary rewrite (fth run.effective_bench → sealed dict). fprime-gds launches the executable itself (--app; no -n) and the deployment's Drv.TcpClient connects to the GDS server on 127.0.0.1:50000; framing is the fprime-gds default (space packets), matching ComCcsds.Subtopology — DEVELOPMENT confirms on the dry run. Downlinked files (L7-1 PrmDb.dat) land in {logs}/files = record/raw/files, sealed with the run. The GDS owns the process: a non-zero exit of the app is a bench fault, not a UUT fact. No reset row: the plan acknowledges L3 as not covered. deployment is empty on purpose: the stimulus sends full dictionary names (CdhCore.* and FileHandling.* commands are not under the FprimeRustReference prefix; fprime-cli refuses suffix names). --deployment {deployment_dir} (the built tree beside the dictionary) is required: fprime-gds 4.x otherwise searches the cwd parents for an F Prime settings.ini and exits when the campaign root is not a project.
